title: Statistical Outlier Removal
hints: First pass: for each point, the mean distance to its k nearest OTHER points. Use knn(pts, p, k + 1) and skip the point itself (careful with duplicates: skip by index, not by distance 0).
Second pass: μ and σ (population: divide by N) of those mean distances. Threshold = μ + α·σ.
Keep i if meanDist[i] ≤ threshold. Using ≤ (not <) is what makes σ = 0 (all identical points) keep everything.
Clamp: k_eff = min(k, N − 1). If N ≤ 1 or k_eff ≤ 0, return all indices.
